propositions: Duplicate workflow-owned CAS delivery loops are consolidated into a single Python core module owned by src/rebar/_store/push.py

push_tickets_branch with strict=False provides best-effort delivery with five-cycle retry budget and optional fetch-and-merge recovery; strict=True raises PushDeliveryError with stable reason and unpushed-commit count
commit_and_push_tickets_branch provides a locked transaction for staged commit and strict push used by automation with established bot identity and commit subject
Workflows delegate delivery exactly once through strict Python adapters; no fetch/merge/retry loops remain in YAML
Existing Python library, CLI, MCP, and importer callers retain best-effort defaults with backward-compatible interfaces
